name: submodules-agent-office
description: A live pixel-art office above your Claude Code prompt: the orchestrator and every subagent it delegates to, animated by what each one is doing.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: How agents are drawn: office, robot or tamagotchi

large.title: Large characters
large.description: Draw 16x20 characters with the text below (a 15-line band) instead of slim 20x10 ones with the text beside them (a 6-line band)

showOnStart.title: Show on start
showOnStart.description: Show the band when a session starts (hide or show it any time with /agent-office)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show how many agents are working in the status line

notify.title: Toasts
notify.description: Show a toast when a subagent finishes or fails
